facts.label: Generation technology
facts.question: What will generate or store the energy?
facts.why: The technology decides which interconnection, net-metering and safety processes can apply.

short_question.en: What will produce or store the energy?

facts.label: Battery storage
facts.question: Will the project include battery energy storage?
facts.why: Battery storage can bring separate fire-safety review and, above 1 MW of storage service, PREB certification.

short_question.en: Will it include batteries?

facts.label: Generation capacity (kW)
facts.question: What is the total generating capacity, in kW (1 MW = 1,000 kW)?
facts.why: Capacity thresholds (25 kW, 300 kW, 1 MW, 5 MW) change net-metering eligibility, insurance, and whether PREB certification applies.

short_question.en: How big is it (kW or MW)?

facts.label: Storage unit capacity (kW)
facts.question: What is the nominal capacity of the largest storage unit, in kW?
facts.why: Offering storage service with a unit of 1 MW or more makes the operator an electric service company under PREB Regulation 8701.

short_question.en: Largest battery unit size (kW)?
short_question.es: ¿Tamaño de la unidad de batería más grande (kW)?

facts.label: Customer class
facts.question: Is the electric account residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, government, educational, or medical?
facts.why: Net-metering capacity limits differ for residential and non-residential customers.

short_question.en: What kind of electric account is it?

facts.label: System ownership
facts.question: Who will own the system — your company, a third party (lease/PPA), a customer cooperative, or a municipality?
facts.why: PREB classifies microgrids by ownership; cooperative, municipal and third-party systems have different obligations.

short_question.en: Who will own the system?

facts.label: Properties/facilities served
facts.question: How many separate buildings or properties will the system serve, including your own?
facts.why: A system serving several facilities may be a microgrid rather than a single-site installation.

short_question.en: How many buildings will it serve?

facts.label: All served buildings have the same owner
facts.question: Are all the buildings the system will serve owned by your company?
facts.why: Under Regulation 9028 a microgrid serving only its owner (one or two customer-owners) that sells nothing is an individual self-supply system with no PREB requirements.

short_question.en: Does your company own all those buildings?
short_question.es: ¿Tu compañía es dueña de todos esos edificios?

facts.label: Customers served
facts.question: How many separate electric customers (account holders) will the system serve?
facts.why: Under PREB Regulation 9028 a microgrid with one or two customer-owners that only self-supplies has no registration requirement; three or more customers does.

question_variants.question: Besides your own buildings, will the system serve any other electric customers (tenants or other businesses)? If so, how many?

short_question.en: How many electric customers will it serve?

facts.label: Sells energy to others
facts.question: Will you sell electricity or energy services to anyone other than yourself?
facts.why: Selling energy is the fact that separates self-supply from regulated microgrid and electric-service-company activity.

question_variants.question: Sharing power among buildings you own is not a sale. Will you also sell electricity to anyone else, such as tenants or other businesses?

short_question.en: Will you sell energy to anyone else?

facts.label: Sells to PREPA/LUMA under a PPA
facts.question: Will you sell power to PREPA/LUMA or another electric company under a power purchase agreement?
facts.why: Generators selling under a PPA are electric service companies under PREB Regulation 8701.

short_question.en: Will you sell power to LUMA/PREPA under a contract?

facts.label: Grid-connected (parallel operation)
facts.question: Will the system operate connected to (in parallel with) the LUMA grid?
facts.why: Only systems that operate in parallel with the grid go through LUMA interconnection; fully off-grid systems do not.

short_question.en: Will it run connected to the LUMA grid?
short_question.es: ¿Operará conectado a la red de LUMA?

facts.label: Interconnection with LUMA required
facts.question: Will the system need to interconnect with LUMA?
facts.why: Interconnection is the controlling fact for LUMA's distributed-generation process.

short_question.en: Will it connect to LUMA?

facts.label: Microgrid configuration
facts.question: Will the system be set up as a microgrid (generation, storage and distribution able to serve loads as its own system)?
facts.why: PREB's microgrid rules apply only to systems configured as microgrids — ordinary rooftop solar is not assumed to be one.

question_variants.question: Will the {properties_served} buildings share power through their own distribution lines and controls (a microgrid), or will each building connect to LUMA separately?

short_question.en: Is it a microgrid?

facts.label: Energy project status
facts.question: Is the energy system already operating, or is it proposed?
facts.why: Existing systems verify standing approvals; proposed systems apply.

short_question.en: Is it already operating?

facts.label: Applicant role
facts.question: Is your company the electricity customer using the system, a developer/owner, an energy-service provider, or an installer?
facts.why: Customer-side, developer, installer and energy-service obligations are different processes.

option_labels.end_use_customer: We use the power at our own facility

short_question.en: What is your role in the project?
short_question.es: ¿Cuál es tu rol en el proyecto?

facts.label: Proposed energy services
facts.question: Which energy services will you offer (generation sales, storage, billing, resale, wheeling, installation, consulting)?
facts.why: Billing, resale, wheeling, and 1 MW+ generation or storage services require PREB electric-service-company certification.

short_question.en: Which energy services will you offer?

facts.label: Interested in energy incentives
facts.question: Are you interested in renewable-energy incentives?
facts.why: Incentives are optional; SmartPR only evaluates them when you want them.

short_question.en: Interested in energy incentives?

facts.label: Wants net metering
facts.question: Do you want to enroll in LUMA net metering (credit for energy exported to the grid)?
facts.why: Net metering is a voluntary program — it is required only if you want export credits.

short_question.en: Do you want net metering?

facts.label: Interconnection voltage
facts.question: Will the system connect at distribution voltage (up to 13.2 kV) or at sub-transmission/transmission voltage (38 kV/115 kV)?
facts.why: Act 114-2007 caps non-residential net metering at 1 MW on distribution and 5 MW on sub-transmission/transmission.

question_variants.question: Where will the plant connect to the grid — at 38 kV sub-transmission or 115 kV transmission (for example, which substation or line), or at distribution voltage?

short_question.en: What voltage will it connect at?

facts.label: Mounting
facts.question: Will the equipment be roof-mounted, ground-mounted, or on a carport/canopy?
facts.why: Ground-mounted installations follow the existing SmartPR construction-permit rule.

short_question.en: Roof, ground or carport?

facts.label: Municipality
facts.question: In which municipality is the project?
facts.why: Permitting jurisdiction (OGPe or a municipality with delegated permitting) depends on the municipality.

short_question.en: Which municipality?

facts.label: Structural work
facts.question: Will the installation require structural work (roof reinforcement, new supports or foundations)?
facts.why: Structural work is one of the conditions SmartPR's existing rules use to require an OGPe construction permit.

short_question.en: Does it need structural work?

facts.label: Who buys the power

option_labels.luma_prepa: Sold to PREPA/LUMA (power purchase agreement / procurement)
option_labels.third_party: Sold to another company or customer

facts.question: Who will use or buy the electricity — your own facility, PREPA/LUMA under a power purchase agreement, or another buyer?
facts.why: Selling output to the grid makes the project an independent power producer (Ley 57-2014 art. 1.3(m)); self-supply makes it distributed generation (art. 1.3(aa)). The two follow different processes.

extraction.en: "power_offtaker" :: "self" | "luma_prepa" | "third_party" — who uses or buys the output. "luma_prepa" only when the plant sells its output to LUMA/PREPA (PPA/PPOA, RFP/procurement, "sell power to LUMA"); exporting excess under net metering is "self".
extraction.es: "power_offtaker" :: "self" | "luma_prepa" | "third_party" — quién usa o compra la energía. "luma_prepa" solo si la planta vende su producción a LUMA/AEE (PPA/PPOA, RFP/subasta, "venderle energía a LUMA"); exportar sobrantes bajo medición neta es "self".

short_question.en: Who buys the power?

facts.label: Grid position

option_labels.front_of_meter: Front of the meter (connects directly to the grid)

facts.question: Will the system sit behind your facility’s meter, or connect directly to the grid in front of the meter?
facts.why: Front-of-meter plants are wholesale generators; behind-the-meter systems are customer-side distributed generation.

extraction.en: "grid_position" :: "behind_the_meter" | "front_of_meter", only when stated (e.g. "behind the meter", "utility-scale plant connected to the grid").
extraction.es: "grid_position" :: "behind_the_meter" | "front_of_meter", solo si se dice (p. ej. "detrás del contador", "planta conectada directamente a la red").

short_question.en: Behind your meter or in front of it?
short_question.es: ¿Detrás de tu contador o frente a él?

facts.label: Facility type
facts.question: Is this a system at an existing facility, or a standalone plant (solar farm / storage plant)?
facts.why: A standalone plant is not distributed generation for its own consumption.

extraction.en: "energy_facility_type" :: "standalone_plant" for a solar farm/park/plant, wind farm, or standalone storage plant; "onsite_system" for a system at an existing home/business facility.
extraction.es: "energy_facility_type" :: "standalone_plant" para una finca/parque/planta solar, parque eólico o planta de almacenamiento independiente; "onsite_system" para un sistema en una instalación existente.

short_question.en: At an existing facility or a standalone plant?
short_question.es: ¿En una instalación existente o una planta independiente?

facts.label: Storage energy (MWh)
facts.question: How much energy can the batteries store, in MWh?
facts.why: Storage size shapes MTR storage obligations and storage contracts.

extraction.en: "storage_energy_mwh" :: battery energy in MWh ("40 MWh of batteries" = 40). Never put MWh into storage_capacity_kw (that is power in kW).
extraction.es: "storage_energy_mwh" :: energía de baterías en MWh ("40 MWh de baterías" = 40). Nunca pongas MWh en storage_capacity_kw (esa es potencia en kW).

short_question.en: How much can the batteries store (MWh)?

facts.label: Site control
facts.question: Do you own or lease the site, or hold an option on it?
facts.why: Procurement proposals are evaluated on site ownership or control.

extraction.en: "site_control" :: "owned" | "leased" | "option_or_agreement" | "none", only when stated for the project site.
extraction.es: "site_control" :: "owned" | "leased" | "option_or_agreement" | "none", solo si se dice sobre el terreno del proyecto.

short_question.en: Do you own, lease or hold an option on the site?
short_question.es: ¿Eres dueño, arrendatario o tienes opción sobre el terreno?

facts.label: Site land classification
facts.question: How is the site zoned — industrial, agricultural, specially protected rustic (SREP), other rustic, or urban?
facts.why: Ground-mounted solar on industrial land is exempt from a public hearing; on other land the Junta Adjudicativa/OGPe may hold one (Reglamento Conjunto § 9.4.1.5). Wind is ministerial only in agricultural or industrial districts (§ 9.3.2.2).

extraction.en: "site_zoning" :: "industrial" | "agricultural" | "specially_protected_rustic" | "other_rustic" | "urban" | "unzoned", only when the land classification/zoning is stated.
extraction.es: "site_zoning" :: "industrial" | "agricultural" | "specially_protected_rustic" | "other_rustic" | "urban" | "unzoned", solo si se dice la calificación del terreno.

short_question.en: How is the land zoned?

facts.label: Environmental sensitivity
facts.question: Is any part of the site in wetlands, an agricultural reserve, the coastal zone, a flood zone, or protected habitat?
facts.why: Each triggers its own review (Corps § 404, coastal consistency, Planning Regulation 13).

extraction.en: "environmental_sensitivity" :: comma-separated from wetlands, agricultural_reserve, coastal_zone, floodplain, protected_habitat, none — only what is stated about the site.
extraction.es: "environmental_sensitivity" :: separados por comas entre wetlands, agricultural_reserve, coastal_zone, floodplain, protected_habitat, none — solo lo que se diga del terreno.

short_question.en: Any wetlands, coast or flood zone on the site?
short_question.es: ¿Hay humedales, costa o zona inundable en el terreno?

facts.label: In a PREB procurement tranche / RFP
facts.question: Was the project selected in (or is it bidding into) a PREB-supervised procurement tranche / RFP?
facts.why: The approved IRP buys new renewable and storage capacity through RFP tranches; the contract path depends on it.

extraction.en: "procurement_tranche" :: true when the speaker says the project is in / was selected in / is bidding into a PREB or PREPA RFP or tranche; false only when they say it is not.
extraction.es: "procurement_tranche" :: true si dice que el proyecto está / fue seleccionado / compite en un RFP o tramo (tranche) del NEPR o la AEE; false solo si dice que no.

short_question.en: Is it in a PREB procurement round (RFP)?

facts.label: Tallest structure (ft)
facts.question: How tall is the tallest structure (e.g. wind turbine tip height), in feet?
facts.why: Structures taller than 200 ft need FAA notice (14 CFR 77.9).

extraction.en: "structure_height_ft" :: tallest structure height in feet, only when stated (convert meters × 3.28).
extraction.es: "structure_height_ft" :: altura de la estructura más alta en pies, solo si se dice (metros × 3.28).

short_question.en: Tallest structure height (ft)?

facts.label: Near an airport
facts.question: Is the site near an airport or heliport?
facts.why: Structures within airport imaginary surfaces need FAA notice (14 CFR 77.9(b)).

extraction.en: "near_airport" :: true when the site is stated to be near an airport/heliport.
extraction.es: "near_airport" :: true si se dice que el terreno está cerca de un aeropuerto o helipuerto.

short_question.en: Is the site near an airport?

requirements.name: Register the system through LUMA's distributed-generation portal
requirements.controlling_language: may interconnect their system in parallel with the Authority's System, after completing the registration thereof, by filing the required documents through the Authority's electronic portal, signing this Agreement

requirements.name: Customer orientation form (Formulario de Orientación al Cliente)
requirements.controlling_language: Formulario de Orientación al Cliente

requirements.name: Equipment certifications
requirements.controlling_language: Certificaciones de Equipos (OGPe)

requirements.name: Certified diagram of the distributed-generation installation
requirements.controlling_language: Diagrama ilustrativo de GD (certificación del diseñador)

requirements.name: Inverter configuration evidence
requirements.controlling_language: Captura de pantalla o certificación del fabricante de la configuración del inversor

requirements.name: Certification of Electrical Installation of Distributed Energy Resources
requirements.controlling_language: responsible for delivering to the Authority, together with the Certification of Electrical Installation of Distributed Energy Resources (RED) of the completed work, the report of the tests performed

requirements.name: Acceptance-test report certified by a licensed electrical engineer
requirements.controlling_language: the report of the tests performed, certified by a licensed and collegiate electrical engineer, authorized to practice the engineering profession in Puerto Rico

requirements.name: Insurance-waiver agreement (inverter-based systems under 300 kW)
requirements.controlling_language: an inverter-based GD, with a capacity of less than three hundred kilowatts (300 kW), with the Authority System, is exempt from a General Public Liability Insurance policy. In these cases, the Customer must sign an Agreement for the Waiver of Insurance Requirement.

requirements.name: General public liability insurance (300 kW and above)
requirements.controlling_language: El cliente debe obtener un seguro de responsabilidad civil para la capacidad de generación distribuida superior a 300 kW
requirements.notes: LUMA's page says 'superior a 300 kW' while the ≤25 kW agreement exempts systems 'less than 300 kW'; a system of exactly 300 kW is ambiguous — needs expert validation.

requirements.name: Installation by a licensed engineer or electrician registered with PPPE (formerly OEPPE)
requirements.controlling_language: Ser instalado por un ingeniero licenciado o un perito electricista licenciado, ambos colegiados … debiendo registrarse tal profesional en la Oficina Estatal de Política Pública Energética

requirements.name: Sign the LUMA net-metering agreement in the DG portal
requirements.controlling_language: El cliente debe firmar el acuerdo de medición neta en el portal de Generación Distribuida

requirements.name: LUMA installs or confirms a bidirectional meter
requirements.controlling_language: el sitio debe tener un medidor bidireccional para medir con precisión la energía que está produciendo el cliente

requirements.name: Construction / use permit where the project requires one
requirements.controlling_language: complying with any other requirements necessary for the interconnection of the project, such as the Use Permit or Single Permit for those projects that require it

requirements.name: Certified electrical construction drawings
requirements.controlling_language: installed in accordance with the Regulations, National Electrical Code (NEC), National Electrical Safety Code (NESC), Regulations for the Certification of Electrical Construction Project Drawings

requirements.name: Fire-safety certification covering the battery installation
requirements.controlling_language: Existing SmartPR rule: Q_SOLAR_BATTERY = true → DOC_FIRE_CERT (citation Ley 20-2017).

requirements.name: PREB microgrid registration application
requirements.controlling_language: Any person interested in developing a Cooperative, Municipal or Third-Party microgrid system, must complete a registration form, as applicable, for the classification of their system.

requirements.name: Owner/representative contact and ownership structure
requirements.controlling_language: The application for registration shall identify the proposed system as a Small Municipal System, Large Municipal System or Third-Party System.

requirements.name: Microgrid location and boundaries
requirements.controlling_language: Location information must include the municipality of the microgrid and a map showing the geographical boundaries of the proposed system.

requirements.name: Number (and type) of customers served
requirements.controlling_language: The application for registration must include the total expected number of customers to be served by the microgrid.

requirements.name: Classification (renewable / CHP / hybrid) and resource plan
requirements.controlling_language: The application for registration must list the planned sizes and types of assets (including, as applicable, generation, storage, inverters, and other major electrical equipment) to be added or connected to the system.

requirements.name: Primary vendor / installer information
requirements.controlling_language: The application for registration shall include the name and contact information for the primary vendor(s) or installer(s) of the system.

requirements.name: Licensed electrical engineer's certification of inspection / compliance
requirements.controlling_language: Un ingeniero colegiado y licenciado deberá certificar que la microred cumple con las especificaciones requeridas por la reglamentación del Negociado para estos proyectos

requirements.name: Model customer contract and sample bill for PREB approval
requirements.controlling_language: A model contract for Commission review and approval, in accordance with Section 6.09 of this Regulation. A sample bill for Commission review and approval.

requirements.name: Registration filing fee ($50 small cooperative; $100 large cooperative, municipal, third-party)
requirements.controlling_language: any application for registration of a microgrid system shall include payment of a filing fee
requirements.notes: Microgrid owners that are electric service companies (§ 6.02) pay the Regulation 8701 fees instead and must show proof of that payment.

requirements.name: Comply with IEEE 1547, UL 1703/1741 and the National Electrical Code
requirements.controlling_language: Microgrids shall be compliant with existing safety standards; namely, IEEE Standard 1547 for design; UL Standard 1703, UL Standard 1741, or IEEE Standard 1547 for equipment; and the National Electric Code

requirements.name: Annual report on generation, fuel use, sales and customer changes
requirements.controlling_language: shall submit an annual report on fuel usage, generation, and sales to the Commission
requirements.notes: Article 4 (small cooperative systems) of the published text has no reporting section; the small-cooperative carve-out rests on that absence and needs expert validation.

requirements.name: Maintain and submit copies of US EPA / environmental-board reports
requirements.controlling_language: must maintain and submit to the Commission copies of any reports required by the US EPA and the Puerto Rico Environmental Quality Board

requirements.name: Personal information filing (NEPR-B01, with NEPR-B02 affiliates sheet)
requirements.controlling_language: toda compañía que se proponga operar u ofrecer servicios en Puerto Rico debe presentar al Negociado de Energía: 1. La Información Personal requerida en la Sec. 2.01 del Reglamento

requirements.name: Operational Report (NEPR-B03)
requirements.controlling_language: the following electric service companies must file before the Commission an Operational Report that includes the information required below

requirements.name: Request for Certification (NEPR-B04)
requirements.controlling_language: no electric service company shall operate or offer any service whatsoever in Puerto Rico without first having requested and obtained a certification from the Energy Commission

requirements.name: Documents, certificates and permits supporting the request
requirements.controlling_language: Requests for Certification must also be accompanied by every document, certificate, or permit that confirms or sustains the information included in the Request

requirements.name: Certification of economic capacity and of permits for new or renovated facilities
requirements.controlling_language: the company must also file a certification that confirms that the company has the economic capacity and solvency to finance the construction and the operation of the facilities, as well as a certification to the effect that the company has obtained or will obtain all the necessary permits
requirements.notes: The source scopes this to companies generating for sale to PREPA/another ESC or offering storage/wheeling; applied here to proposed facilities generally — expert should confirm scope for distributed-generation sellers.

requirements.name: Gross revenue and financial statements (NEPR-B05); annual regulatory charge
requirements.controlling_language: Duty to Inform Gross Revenue
requirements.notes: Annual-charge amounts were amended by Regulation 9182 (2020) and Act 17-2019; not modeled as numbers.

requirements.name: PPPE installer certification application
requirements.controlling_language: Favor de completar esta solicitud en todas sus partes y enviarla junto a los documentos aplicables en PDF al correo electrónico energia@ddec.pr.gov

requirements.name: Installer course (or NABCEP) approval certificate
requirements.locator: Curso de Instalador de Sistemas Eléctricos Renovables
requirements.controlling_language: Certificado de aprobación de curso

requirements.name: Professional license copy (engineer or electrician; colegiación for engineers)
requirements.controlling_language: Copia de licencia profesional (incluir especialidad y evidencia de colegiación en caso de ingenieros)

requirements.name: Engage in an eligible green-energy activity
requirements.controlling_language: Any business engaged in the production or sale, at a commercial level, of Green Energy for consumption in Puerto Rico … (8) Assembly of Green Energy generation equipment, including the installation of such equipment at the facilities of the user

requirements.name: Apply to the Secretary of DDEC for an incentives decree
requirements.controlling_language: may file an application for Incentives with the Secretary of the DEDC when the Entity is established in Puerto Rico to engage in one of the following eligible activities

requirements.name: Hold an Act 60 green-energy decree; equipment not previously used or depreciated in Puerto Rico
requirements.controlling_language: Any Exempt Business holding a Decree granted under this Chapter shall be granted the option of deducting … provided, that these buildings, structures, machinery, and equipment: (1) Have not depreciated or been previously used by any other business or Person in Puerto Rico

requirements.name: Submit a proposal that meets the RFP requirements (technology, capacity, MTR compliance strategy, grid connection point, COD, ownership)
requirements.controlling_language: (5) MTR compliance strategy; (6) grid connection point and electrical one-line diagrams; (7) ancillary service capabilities; (8) forecasted commercial operation date; and (9) ownership structure

requirements.name: Show site ownership, lease or the ability to control the site before the guaranteed construction start
requirements.locator: Joint Motion (2021-07-23), evaluation criterion viii (Site Control)
requirements.controlling_language: The Project Committee will assess whether a Proponent owns or leases the project site (and, in the case of a lease, will consider the alignment of the term of such lease with the term of the applicable Contract) or otherwise has the ability to obtain control over, and access to, such site

requirements.name: Environmental permitting plan covering all potentially applicable federal and local permits
requirements.controlling_language: Environmental permitting plan addressing all potentially applicable environmental permits (federal and local)

requirements.name: Transmission/distribution interconnection plan meeting the MTRs and Reg. 8915 or 8916
requirements.controlling_language: Transmission or distribution upgrade plans, as applicable, demonstrating compliance with the requirements of Regulation 8915 or Regulation 8916, as applicable, status of interconnection or transmission service requests, and status of related agreements and approvals

requirements.name: Negotiate the power purchase and operating agreement (PPOA) with PREPA
requirements.controlling_language: the Energy Bureau ACCEPTS PREPA’s filing of these nine (9) executed PPOA contracts … Therefore, the Energy Bureau APPROVES the executed contracts in Attachment A.

requirements.name: Negotiate the energy storage services agreement (ESSA) with PREPA
requirements.controlling_language: mediante evaluaciones independientes, se han aprobado varios contratos para la compra de energía y de servicios de almacenamiento de energía, ello, conforme a lo dispuesto en la Sección 6.32 de la Ley 57-2014.

requirements.name: Energy Bureau evaluates and approves the contract before it is signed (PREPA files it)
requirements.controlling_language: El Negociado de Energía evaluará y aprobará todos los contratos entre las compañías de servicio eléctrico, incluidos los productores independientes de energía, antes del otorgamiento de dichos contratos. Esto incluirá, pero no se limitará, a la evaluación y aprobación de los contratos de compraventa de energía mediante los cuales un productor independiente de energía se disponga a proveer energía a la compañía de servicio eléctrico responsable de operar el Sistema Eléctrico.

requirements.name: File a notice of intent with the Energy Bureau before building (180-day response)
requirements.controlling_language: Toda compañía de energía certificada que desee construir o expandir sus instalaciones deberá cumplir con la Ley de Política Pública Energética y presentar al Negociado una notificación de intención sobre el proyecto, conforme con las normas y reglamentos que esta establezca.
requirements.notes: No implementing regulation for notices of intent was located; confirm whether PREB requires a separate notice for IPPs selected through an RFP.

requirements.name: Interconnection request with the grid connection point and one-line diagram
requirements.controlling_language: (6) grid connection point and electrical one-line diagrams

requirements.name: Optional feasibility study (only if you request it)
requirements.controlling_language: Se llevará a cabo un estudio de viabilidad solo a solicitud del Cliente de Interconexión, El Operador del SEE no requerirá un estudio de viabilidad.

requirements.name: LUMA performs the System Impact Study
requirements.controlling_language: This final technical interconnection study is composed of the following studies: the System Impact Study, the Point of Interconnection Facility Study, the Network Upgrades Facility Study (the latter two jointly, referred to as the “Facility Studies”) and the Minimum Technical Requirements (“MTR”) Compliance Study

requirements.name: Transmission System impact study (38 kV / 115 kV connections)
requirements.controlling_language: Junto con los resultados del estudio de impacto al sistema o, de requerirse, del estudio de impacto al Sistema de Transmisión.
requirements.notes: In the drafts, the Transmission System means the 38 kV sub-transmission and 115 kV transmission facilities.

requirements.name: LUMA performs the Point-of-Interconnection and Network Upgrades Facility Studies (upgrade costs)
requirements.controlling_language: This final technical interconnection study is composed of the following studies: the System Impact Study, the Point of Interconnection Facility Study, the Network Upgrades Facility Study (the latter two jointly, referred to as the “Facility Studies”) and the Minimum Technical Requirements (“MTR”) Compliance Study

requirements.name: Provide PSS/E steady-state and dynamic models of the facility
requirements.controlling_language: an assessment of each proponent-provided electrical power system simulation file (PSS/E model) of their proposed facility, for both steady-state and dynamic conditions is performed.

requirements.name: Sign the interconnection agreement after the studies
requirements.controlling_language: el Operador del SEE proveerá al Cliente de Interconexión un Acuerdo de Interconexión de acuerdo con el siguiente calendario: (1) Dentro cinco (5) Días Laborables a partir de que se complete el informe final del estudio de instalaciones.
requirements.notes: For plants selling to PREPA, interconnection terms may be set in the PPOA instead; needs expert validation.

requirements.name: Meet the PV Minimum Technical Requirements (ride-through, voltage and reactive power, frequency response, ramp rate)
requirements.locator: Appendix H — MTRs for PV facilities (V3), preamble
requirements.controlling_language: MINIMUM TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERCONNECTION OF PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) FACILITIES The Seller shall comply with the following minimum technical requirements

requirements.name: PV MTRs require energy storage for frequency response (≥10% of contracted capacity for 9.5 min) and ramp-rate control (≥30% for 25 min)
requirements.locator: Appendix H — MTRs for PV facilities (V3), frequency response / ramp rate
requirements.controlling_language: the energy storage system shall include, as a minimum: 10% of the contracted capacity for Frequency Response/Regulation for at least 9.5 minutes (see section 6 for details) and 30% of contracted capacity for Ramp Rate Control for at least 25 minutes.

requirements.name: Meet the wind (WTG) Minimum Technical Requirements
requirements.locator: Appendix H — MTRs for WTG projects (V3.1), preamble
requirements.controlling_language: MINIMUM TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERCONNECTION OF WIND TURBINE GENERATION (WTG) PROJECTS The Seller shall comply with the following minimum technical requirements

requirements.name: Meet the BESS Minimum Technical Requirements (frequency control, fast frequency response, reactive support, power quality)
requirements.locator: Appendix H — MTRs for BESS facilities, preamble
requirements.controlling_language: The Seller for BEES facilities shall comply with the following minimum technical requirements

requirements.name: After commissioning tests, submit a certified PSS/E model and validation report
requirements.locator: Appendix H — MTRs for PV facilities (V3), § 13 Modeling and Validation
requirements.controlling_language: Once final adjustments and parameter settings related with commissioning and MTR compliance tests are completed, the Seller shall submit a PSS/e Siemens – PTI Certified mathematical model and validation report.

requirements.name: File a consulta de ubicación (land-use siting review) with OGPe / the Junta Adjudicativa
requirements.controlling_language: “Consulta de ubicación” — Es el procedimiento ante la Oficina de Gerencia de Permisos … para que evalúen, pasen juicio y tomen la determinación que estimen pertinente sobre propuestos usos de terrenos que no son permitidos ministerialmente

requirements.name: Possible public hearing (discretionary unless the site is zoned industrial)
requirements.controlling_language: Todos los sistemas solares fotovoltaicos a ser instalados sobre el terreno, incluyendo los de gran escala, que sean ubicados y construidos en distritos con calificación industrial. … Para las demás calificaciones la Junta Adjudicativa o la OGPe o los Municipios Autónomos con Jerarquía de la I a la III, se reservan la facultad de determinar si es necesaria la celebración de una vista pública

requirements.name: Large-scale PV documents: property plan, PE-signed construction plans, electrical diagram, component documentation
requirements.controlling_language: El proponente de la instalación solar fotovoltaica a gran escala deberá proveer los siguientes documentos

requirements.name: Give Bomberos, Police and hospitals a project summary, schematics and fire contingency plan
requirements.controlling_language: El dueño u operador de la instalación solar fotovoltaica deberá proveer un resumen del proyecto, esquemáticos eléctricos, plan de contingencia para casos de incendio a las autoridades locales tales como el Negociado del Cuerpo de Bomberos, el Negociado de la Policía, y Hospitales.

requirements.name: Request AEE/LUMA’s interconnection evaluation (distribution, or transmission/sub-transmission form)
requirements.controlling_language: Solicitud para evaluación de la AEE para los proyectos a interconectarse con su sistema eléctrico

requirements.name: Specially protected rustic / agricultural land: heightened interdisciplinary review (specific restrictions not modeled)
requirements.controlling_language: Para todo suelo clasificado Suelo Rústico Especialmente Protegido (SREP) y áreas especiales con riesgo a inundación conforme designadas por la FEMA
requirements.notes: No primary source reviewed sets agricultural-reserve limits on solar; confirm with a land-use expert.

requirements.name: Obtain the environmental recommendation (REA) before filing an EA or DIA
requirements.controlling_language: La REA es un requisito compulsorio previo a la radicación de una EA o DIA.

requirements.name: Environmental document — Environmental Assessment (EA), Environmental Impact Statement (DIA), or a sworn categorical-exclusion certification, as OGPe determines
requirements.controlling_language: El individuo o el profesional que prepare el documento ambiental o el formulario reclamando la aplicabilidad de una exclusión categórica, certificará, bajo juramento

requirements.name: OGPe issues the environmental compliance determination (required before any final permit)
requirements.controlling_language: emitir, antes de efectuar cualquier acción o promulgar cualquier decisión gubernamental que afecte significativamente la calidad del medioambiente, una declaración escrita y detallada sobre: a) El impacto ambiental

requirements.name: Sealed, digitally signed construction plans (with DXF site polygon, NAD 83)
requirements.controlling_language: Planos de construcción del proyecto, los cuales tendrán que estar sellados y firmados digitalmente por el profesional licenciado responsable del diseño de los mismos.

requirements.name: Plans must include every requirement from the AEE evaluation (plants selling to AEE under a PPOA)
requirements.controlling_language: Cuando el propósito del sistema de generación sea exclusivamente la venta de energía a la AEE mediante un contrato de compra de energía (PPOA), los planos tienen que incluir todos los requisitos establecidos en el proceso de evaluación por la AEE para la adecuada construcción y operación del sistema.

requirements.name: Flood-zone certification from the Junta de Planificación
requirements.controlling_language: Se deberá someter certificación de inundabilidad, emitida por la JP, en caso de obras de construcción.

requirements.name: AEE/LUMA evaluates and authorizes the interconnection before construction starts
requirements.controlling_language: Aquellos sistemas que se interconectarán con el sistema eléctrico de la AEE, sin importar su capacidad, requerirán una evaluación y autorización de dicha entidad antes de iniciarse el proceso de construcción.

requirements.name: Acceptance tests, inspection and installation certification after construction
requirements.controlling_language: Una vez el proyecto sea construido, se procederá a realizar las pruebas de aceptación, inspeccionar y certificar la instalación del sistema de energía renovable según aplique conforme a la reglamentación vigente de la AEE.

requirements.name: Permiso Único for operation and energization (installer, installation and inspector certifications; final system description)
requirements.controlling_language: el dueño o su representante autorizado podrá solicitar a la OGPe o al Municipio Autónomo con Jerarquía de la I a la III, el permiso único correspondiente

requirements.name: AEE verifies the PPOA evaluation requirements before energizing
requirements.controlling_language: En caso de que el propósito del sistema de generación sea exclusivamente la venta de energía a la AEE mediante un contrato de compra de energía (PPOA), para energizar el proyecto, la AEE verificará que se cumpla con todos los requisitos establecidos por la AEE en el proceso de evaluación y certificación de planos

requirements.name: AEE/LUMA allows interconnection within 5 days after the Permiso Único (absent serious deficiencies)
requirements.controlling_language: ésta permitirá la interconexión del sistema en un periodo máximo de (5) días después de la emisión de este permiso

requirements.name: Written authorization before starting parallel operation
requirements.controlling_language: Autorización Requerida Antes de Comenzar la Operación en Paralelo

requirements.name: Public liability insurance
requirements.controlling_language: Seguro de Responsabilidad Pública.

requirements.name: Corps permit (or jurisdictional determination / general permit) for fill in waters or wetlands
requirements.controlling_language: DA permits will be required for the discharge of dredged or fill material into waters of the United States.

requirements.name: Coastal-zone consistency certification with the federal permit application
requirements.controlling_language: all applicants for required federal licenses or permits subject to State agency review shall provide … a certification that the proposed activity complies with … the management program

requirements.name: Comply with Planning Regulation 13 (flood zones)
requirements.controlling_language: Si el inmueble objeto de la solicitud ubica en un área susceptible a inundaciones, según el Mapa de Tasas del Seguro de Inundaciones, deberá cumplir con las disposiciones del Reglamento de Planificación Núm. 13 vigente.

requirements.name: File FAA Form 7460-1 notice and obtain the FAA determination
requirements.controlling_language: you must file notice with the FAA of: (a) Any construction or alteration that is more than 200 ft. AGL at its site.

processes.name: Distributed-generation interconnection with LUMA

portal.label: LUMA distributed-generation portal
portal.label_es: Portal de generación distribuida de LUMA

applicability.trigger_summary: The system will operate in parallel with (interconnected to) the LUMA grid.
applicability.controlling_language: GD Customers with a capacity of 25 kW or less may interconnect their system in parallel with the Authority's System, after completing the registration thereof, by filing the required documents through the Authority's electronic portal
applicability.notes: Above 25 kW the same process applies under Regulation 8915 with additional LUMA technical review (LUMA Paso 4); those extra steps are not modeled.

exceptions.reason: Off-grid only: systems that never operate in parallel with the grid are outside interconnection rules.
exceptions.controlling_language: excepto aquellas que solo operan independiente del Sistema de Energía Eléctrica (i. e. las que no sean de Operación en Paralelo)

prerequisites.note: Use Permit or Single Permit for those projects that require it.

processes.summary: Register the system with LUMA before it runs connected to the grid.
processes.summary_es: Registra el sistema con LUMA antes de operarlo conectado a la red.

processes.name: Net-metering program enrollment (LUMA)

portal.label: LUMA distributed-generation portal
portal.label_es: Portal de generación distribuida de LUMA

processes.gate_reason: Net metering exists only for systems interconnected in parallel with the grid.

applicability.trigger_summary: You want net-metering credit for energy exported to the grid.
applicability.controlling_language: El cliente solicita a LUMA para medición neta a través del portal de Generación Distribuida

applicability.trigger_summary: A grid-connected renewable system may enroll in net metering; it is a voluntary program.
applicability.controlling_language: establecer y mantener un programa de medición neta (net metering) que permita la interconexión a la red eléctrica para permitir la retroalimentación de electricidad a los clientes que hayan instalado un equipo solar eléctrico, molino de viento o cualquier otra fuente de energía renovable

exceptions.reason: Residential net metering is limited to 25 kW.
exceptions.controlling_language: Poseer una capacidad generatriz no mayor de veinticinco kilovatios (25 kW) para clientes residenciales

exceptions.reason: Non-residential net metering is limited to 1 MW at distribution voltage.
exceptions.controlling_language: un megavatio (1 MW) para clientes comerciales, gubernamentales e industriales o agrícolas, o instituciones educativas o facilidades médico-hospitalarias conectados a voltajes de distribución (hasta 13.2kV)

exceptions.reason: Non-residential net metering is limited to 5 MW at sub-transmission/transmission voltage.
exceptions.controlling_language: cinco megavatios (5MW) para clientes comerciales, gubernamentales e industriales o agrícolas … conectados a voltajes de sub-transmisión o transmisión (38 kV o 115 kV)

exceptions.reason: Above 5 MW no customer class can enroll in net metering; the Act 114-2007 ceiling is 5 MW (25 kW for residential).
exceptions.controlling_language: cinco megavatios (5MW) para clientes comerciales, gubernamentales e industriales o agrícolas … conectados a voltajes de sub-transmisión o transmisión (38 kV o 115 kV)

exceptions.reason: Wholesale plants that sell their output are independent power producers, not distributed generators, so net metering does not apply.
exceptions.controlling_language: “Generador distribuido” — Significará cualquier persona natural o jurídica, que tenga una instalación de generación eléctrica en Puerto Rico primordialmente para su propio consumo y que puede proveer electricidad generada en exceso de su consumo a la red eléctrica.

prerequisites.note: LUMA validates and approves the interconnection before the net-metering agreement and meter change.

processes.voluntary_note: Net metering is a voluntary program (Ley 114-2007 Art. 1): these steps apply only if you choose to enroll to receive credit for exported energy.
processes.summary: Optional LUMA program that credits the energy you export.
processes.summary_es: Programa opcional de LUMA que acredita la energía que exportas.

processes.name: Microgrid registration with the Energy Bureau

portal.label: PREB online filing (Radicación en línea)
portal.label_es: Radicación en línea del Negociado de Energía

processes.gate_reason: PREB microgrid rules apply only to systems configured as microgrids.

applicability.trigger_summary: The microgrid will serve three or more separate customers (small or large system).
applicability.controlling_language: Small systems are those with at least three (3) and no more than ten (10) customers or customer-owners and total generating capacity of no more than 250 kW; or, Large systems are those with more than 10 customers or generating capacity over 250 kW.

applicability.trigger_summary: The microgrid will sell energy or grid services to others (not self-supply).
applicability.controlling_language: Self-supply microgrids may not sell energy and/or other grid services outside of their self-supply system to entities other than PREPA.

applicability.trigger_summary: The microgrid is owned by a customer cooperative or a municipality.
applicability.controlling_language: Any person interested in developing a small cooperative microgrid must submit an application for registration as described in Article 7 of this Regulation.

exceptions.reason: Individual self-supply microgrid (one or two customer-owners — e.g. one company serving only buildings it owns — and no sales): no requirements under Regulation 9028.
exceptions.controlling_language: “Customer” means any natural person or legal entity who consumes or uses electric power or energy services. … Individual systems are those with one or two customer-owners … There are no requirements for individual self-supply systems under this Regulation.
exceptions.notes: Treating one legal entity serving several buildings it owns as a single customer-owner follows the Customer definition; confirm with an energy-regulatory expert (a single for-profit owner is also the 'third-party' ownership class in § 2.01(B)(6), whose Article 6 registration duty is framed around sales to customers).

exceptions.controlling_language: The requirements for systems owned by PREPA are outside the scope of this Regulation.

prerequisites.note: Only a microgrid owner that is an electric service company under Regulation 8701 § 1.08(A)(5) — e.g. one that sells energy — must also meet Regulation 8701. A self-supply microgrid does not.
prerequisites.controlling_language: Any microgrid owner considered as an Electric Service Company, as such term is defined in Section 1.08(A)(5) of Regulation 8701, shall, in addition to complying with the requirements set forth in this Regulation, comply with any and all applicable requirements set forth in Regulation 8701.

processes.summary: Register the microgrid with the Energy Bureau.
processes.summary_es: Registra la microrred con el Negociado de Energía.

processes.name: Microgrid ongoing compliance (codes, reporting)

portal.label: PREB online filing (Radicación en línea)
portal.label_es: Radicación en línea del Negociado de Energía

applicability.trigger_summary: A registered microgrid must keep meeting PREB's technical standards and reporting duties.
applicability.controlling_language: Microgrids shall be compliant with existing safety standards … The cooperative shall submit an annual report on fuel usage, generation, and sales to the Commission.

prerequisites.note: Ongoing obligations start once PREB grants permission to operate as a microgrid.

processes.summary: Codes, standards and annual reporting after registration.
processes.summary_es: Códigos, normas e informes anuales después del registro.

processes.name: Electric service company certification (Energy Bureau)

portal.label: PREB online filing (Radicación en línea)
portal.label_es: Radicación en línea del Negociado de Energía

processes.gate_reason: Generating for your own consumption (including net-metered distributed generation) is not an electric-service-company activity.
processes.gate_controlling_language: This shall not include persons that generate electric power for their own consumption by means of distributed generation that have net metering agreements with PREPA

applicability.trigger_summary: Sells power generated by grid-interconnected distributed generators with 1 MW or more of aggregate capacity.
applicability.controlling_language: Electric power generation for sale in Puerto Rico through distributed generators that are interconnected to the PREPA power grid with an aggregate capacity of one megawatt (1 MW) or more

applicability.trigger_summary: Sells power to PREPA/LUMA or another electric service company under a power purchase agreement.
applicability.controlling_language: Any natural or legal person that generates electric power through the use of fossil fuels or renewable energy sources for sale to PREPA or any other electric service company in accordance with a power purchase agreement.

applicability.trigger_summary: Offers electric power billing, resale, or transmission (wheeling) service.
applicability.controlling_language: Electric power billing; or Electric power resale. … Any natural or legal person that that carries out or offers electric power transmission (wheeling) service.

applicability.trigger_summary: Offers electric power storage with at least one unit of 1 MW or more.
applicability.controlling_language: Electric power storage, where at least one storage unit has a nominal capacity of one megawatt (1 MW) or more

applicability.trigger_summary: Generates power for sale to PREPA/LUMA (independent power producer).
applicability.controlling_language: Any natural or legal person that generates electric power through the use of fossil fuels or renewable energy sources for sale to PREPA or any other electric service company in accordance with a power purchase agreement.

applicability.trigger_summary: Provides storage services of 1 MW or more to PREPA/LUMA.
applicability.controlling_language: Electric power storage, where at least one storage unit has a nominal capacity of one megawatt (1 MW) or more

processes.summary: Companies that sell power or storage services must be certified by the Energy Bureau.
processes.summary_es: Las compañías que venden energía o servicios de almacenamiento deben certificarse con el Negociado.

processes.name: Renewable-systems installer certification (DDEC-PPPE)

applicability.trigger_summary: Your company installs renewable generation for net-metering customers.
applicability.controlling_language: Ser instalado por un ingeniero licenciado o un perito electricista licenciado … debiendo registrarse tal profesional en la Oficina Estatal de Política Pública Energética
applicability.notes: The statute conditions net-metering eligibility of the installed system on a registered installer; the certification attaches to the installing professional.

processes.summary: Renewable-system installers must be certified by DDEC-PPPE.
processes.summary_es: Los instaladores de sistemas renovables deben certificarse con DDEC-PPPE.

processes.name: Construction / use permit for the energy installation
processes.jurisdiction_note: Filed with OGPe, or with the municipal permits office where the municipality holds delegated permitting authority. SmartPR does not yet hold the delegation list — confirm with the municipality.

applicability.trigger_summary: Ground-mounted installation, generation above 1 MW, or structural work (existing SmartPR permit rules).
applicability.controlling_language: Existing SmartPR rules: Q_SOLAR_MOUNTING = Ground-mounted → DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT; Q_SOLAR_SIZE = Over 1 MW → DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT; structural_work = true → DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT (citation Ley 161-2009).

applicability.trigger_summary: LUMA conditions interconnection on any use/single permit the project needs.
applicability.controlling_language: Customer will obtain and maintain all permits and inspections indicating that the GD complies with all applicable building and safety codes.

processes.summary: A construction or use permit for the installation, when the project needs one.
processes.summary_es: Permiso de construcción o uso para la instalación, cuando el proyecto lo requiere.

processes.name: Fire-safety review for battery energy storage

applicability.trigger_summary: Battery energy storage is part of the project (existing SmartPR battery rule).
applicability.controlling_language: Existing SmartPR rule: Q_SOLAR_BATTERY = true → DOC_FIRE_CERT (citation Ley 20-2017).

processes.summary: Bomberos reviews battery storage installations.
processes.summary_es: Bomberos revisa las instalaciones de almacenamiento en baterías.

processes.name: Competitive procurement (PREB-supervised RFP tranche)
processes.gate_reason: Only for plants that sell their output to PREPA/LUMA.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: The project is in (or bidding into) a PREB-supervised procurement tranche.
applicability.controlling_language: el PIR Aprobado ordena a la Autoridad la confección de un plan de adquisición de recursos de energía renovable y almacenamiento de energía en baterías mediante requerimientos de propuestas (request for proposals o RFPs) en seis (6) fases o tramos (tranches).

applicability.trigger_summary: Selling new capacity to PREPA outside a tranche: PREB’s IRP order routes utility procurement through competitive RFPs; whether a PPOA is possible without one needs expert validation.
applicability.locator: IRP Final Order, as quoted in the Joint Motion (2021-07-23), § 3
applicability.controlling_language: PREPA or the T&D Operator, with oversight by the Energy Bureau under the processes of Regulation 8815, shall run all competitive auctions

processes.summary: Utility power contracts are normally awarded through a PREB-supervised procurement round.
processes.summary_es: Los contratos de venta a la utilidad normalmente se adjudican en una subasta supervisada por el NEPR.

processes.name: Power purchase (PPOA) / storage services (ESSA) contract — Energy Bureau approval
processes.gate_reason: Only for plants that sell their output to PREPA/LUMA.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: The plant will sell energy or storage services to PREPA/LUMA; the Energy Bureau must approve the contract before it is signed.
applicability.controlling_language: El Negociado de Energía evaluará y aprobará todos los contratos entre las compañías de servicio eléctrico, incluidos los productores independientes de energía, antes del otorgamiento de dichos contratos. Esto incluirá, pero no se limitará, a la evaluación y aprobación de los contratos de compraventa de energía mediante los cuales un productor independiente de energía se disponga a proveer energía a la compañía de servicio eléctrico responsable de operar el Sistema Eléctrico.

prerequisites.note: Tranche projects negotiate the PPOA after RFP selection.

processes.short_name_es: Contrato de compraventa (PPOA) — aprobación del NEPR
processes.summary: The Energy Bureau must approve the power (or storage) contract before it is signed.
processes.summary_es: El Negociado debe aprobar el contrato de energía (o almacenamiento) antes de firmarse.

processes.name: Notice of intent to build generation (Energy Bureau)

portal.label: PREB online filing (Radicación en línea)
portal.label_es: Radicación en línea del Negociado de Energía

processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: A certified energy company that builds or expands facilities must notify the Energy Bureau; the implementing procedure was not located.
applicability.controlling_language: Toda compañía de energía certificada que desee construir o expandir sus instalaciones deberá cumplir con la Ley de Política Pública Energética y presentar al Negociado una notificación de intención sobre el proyecto, conforme con las normas y reglamentos que esta establezca.
applicability.notes: Art. 6.34(c): approval does not exempt the project from municipal, state or federal procedures.

processes.summary: Notify the Energy Bureau before building new generation.
processes.summary_es: Notifica al Negociado antes de construir generación nueva.

processes.name: Utility-scale interconnection studies (LUMA)
processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: A wholesale plant connecting to the grid goes through LUMA’s technical interconnection studies.
applicability.controlling_language: This final technical interconnection study is composed of the following studies: the System Impact Study, the Point of Interconnection Facility Study, the Network Upgrades Facility Study (the latter two jointly, referred to as the “Facility Studies”) and the Minimum Technical Requirements (“MTR”) Compliance Study
applicability.notes: Describes LUMA’s practice for PREB-approved procurement projects. No regulation in force codifies utility-scale study steps: the 2021 draft (Art. 4) did; the 2026 draft covers only distributed generation. Needs expert validation outside a tranche.

prerequisites.note: For tranche projects LUMA studies the selected proposals.

processes.summary: LUMA studies how the plant affects the grid and what upgrades it needs.
processes.summary_es: LUMA estudia cómo la planta afecta la red y qué mejoras necesita.

processes.name: Minimum Technical Requirements (MTR) compliance
processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: Utility-scale plants must meet PREPA’s Minimum Technical Requirements to interconnect.
applicability.controlling_language: A project that is not compliant with the MTRs will not be allowed to interconnect.
applicability.notes: MTR text is the 2020 version attached to the RFP (PV V3, WTG V3.1); confirm the current LUMA version.

processes.summary: The plant must meet LUMA's minimum technical requirements.
processes.summary_es: La planta debe cumplir los requisitos técnicos mínimos de LUMA.

processes.name: Interconnection agreement (LUMA)
processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: After the studies, the plant signs interconnection terms with the grid operator.
applicability.controlling_language: el Operador del SEE proveerá al Cliente de Interconexión un Acuerdo de Interconexión
applicability.notes: Draft regulation; for PPOA sellers the terms may sit in the PPOA. Needs expert validation.

prerequisites.note: The agreement follows the final facility study.

processes.summary: Sign the interconnection agreement with LUMA after the studies.
processes.summary_es: Firma el acuerdo de interconexión con LUMA después de los estudios.

processes.name: Land-use siting review (consulta de ubicación)
processes.jurisdiction_note: Autonomous municipalities with hierarchy I–III may evaluate instead of OGPe (Reglamento Conjunto § 9.4.1.5(b)).

applicability.trigger_summary: Ground-mounted solar larger than 1 MW is evaluated by the Junta Adjudicativa through a consulta de ubicación.
applicability.controlling_language: Aquellas instalaciones solares fotovoltaicas, que sean instaladas sobre el terreno, cuya capacidad sea mayor de un megavatio (1 MW) serán evaluadas por la Junta Adjudicativa en el proceso de Consulta de Ubicación y por la OGPe para la otorgación de los permisos correspondientes.

applicability.trigger_summary: Wind outside agricultural or industrial districts (or on unzoned land) needs a consulta de ubicación.
applicability.controlling_language: Los proyectos de ubicación, construcción, instalación y operación de sistemas de generación de energía eólica, sin importar su tamaño, a ser ubicados en distritos distintos a los previamente mencionados, o en áreas no calificadas, sólo podrán ser considerados mediante el mecanismo de Consulta de Ubicación.

applicability.trigger_summary: Standalone battery storage is not a listed use in the Reglamento Conjunto; a use not permitted ministerially goes to consulta. Needs expert validation.
applicability.controlling_language: sobre propuestos usos de terrenos que no son permitidos ministerialmente y que no pueden considerarse mediante otro mecanismo

prerequisites.note: No final land-use determination until the environmental compliance determination is issued.

processes.short_name_es: Revisión de ubicación / uso de suelo
processes.summary: OGPe reviews whether the site can host the plant (consulta de ubicación).
processes.summary_es: OGPe evalúa si el terreno puede acoger la planta (consulta de ubicación).

processes.name: Environmental compliance determination (Ley 416-2004 / OGPe)

applicability.trigger_summary: A wholesale plant or a ground-mounted system over 100 kW needs discretionary permits, and no final permit issues before the environmental compliance determination.
applicability.controlling_language: Bajo ningún concepto se podrá emitir una determinación final hasta tanto se emita la determinación de cumplimiento ambiental.

processes.summary: OGPe must issue an environmental determination before any final permit.
processes.summary_es: OGPe debe emitir una determinación ambiental antes de cualquier permiso final.

processes.name: Construction permit for the plant (OGPe)
processes.jurisdiction_note: Autonomous municipalities with hierarchy I–III may issue the permit instead of OGPe.
processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: Only rooftop PV up to 1 MW and ground systems up to 100 kW are exempt from a construction permit.
applicability.controlling_language: Tampoco se requerirá un permiso de construcción para aquellos sistemas de hasta cien kilovatios (100 Kw) sobre suelo.

prerequisites.note: Siting approval comes before the construction permit.
No final permit before the environmental compliance determination.
AEE must evaluate and authorize the interconnection before construction starts.

processes.summary: A construction permit for the plant.
processes.summary_es: Permiso de construcción para la planta.

processes.name: Testing, commissioning, Permiso Único and commercial operation (COD)
processes.gate_reason: Applies only to wholesale (utility-scale) plants that sell their output — not to customer-side systems.
processes.gate_controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

applicability.trigger_summary: After construction the plant must pass acceptance tests and obtain the Permiso Único before LUMA energizes it.
applicability.controlling_language: Una vez el proyecto sea construido, se procederá a realizar las pruebas de aceptación, inspeccionar y certificar la instalación del sistema de energía renovable según aplique conforme a la reglamentación vigente de la AEE.

prerequisites.note: Built under an approved construction permit.
Non-MTR-compliant plants are not allowed to interconnect.
Energization verifies the PPOA evaluation requirements.

processes.summary: Acceptance tests, Permiso Único and LUMA authorization before commercial operation.
processes.summary_es: Pruebas de aceptación, Permiso Único y autorización de LUMA antes de la operación comercial.

processes.name: Army Corps permit for fill in wetlands or waters (CWA § 404)

applicability.trigger_summary: Wetlands or waters on the site: a Corps permit is needed only if fill is discharged into waters of the U.S.
applicability.controlling_language: DA permits will be required for the discharge of dredged or fill material into waters of the United States.
applicability.notes: Nationwide/regional general permits and § 323.4 exemptions may apply; a jurisdictional determination decides coverage.

processes.summary: Filling wetlands or waters needs a U.S. Army Corps permit.
processes.summary_es: Rellenar humedales o cuerpos de agua requiere permiso del Cuerpo de Ingenieros.

processes.name: Coastal-zone consistency certification

applicability.trigger_summary: Coastal-zone site: a consistency certification is needed if the project requires a federal license or permit.
applicability.controlling_language: all applicants for required federal licenses or permits subject to State agency review shall provide … a certification that the proposed activity complies with … the management program

processes.summary: Projects in the coastal zone need a consistency certification.
processes.summary_es: Los proyectos en la zona costanera necesitan una certificación de compatibilidad.

processes.name: Flood-zone compliance (Planning Regulation 13)

applicability.trigger_summary: The site is in a flood-susceptible area.
applicability.controlling_language: Si el inmueble objeto de la solicitud ubica en un área susceptible a inundaciones, según el Mapa de Tasas del Seguro de Inundaciones, deberá cumplir con las disposiciones del Reglamento de Planificación Núm. 13 vigente.

processes.summary: Sites in a flood zone must meet Planning Regulation 13.
processes.summary_es: Los terrenos en zona inundable deben cumplir el Reglamento 13.

processes.name: FAA notice of proposed construction (Form 7460-1)

portal.label: FAA OE/AAA filing portal
portal.label_es: Portal de radicación OE/AAA de la FAA

applicability.trigger_summary: A structure taller than 200 ft above ground.
applicability.controlling_language: you must file notice with the FAA of: (a) Any construction or alteration that is more than 200 ft. AGL at its site.

applicability.trigger_summary: Near an airport: notice is required if the structure exceeds the airport’s imaginary surfaces.
applicability.controlling_language: Any construction or alteration that exceeds an imaginary surface extending outward and upward at any of the following slopes: (1) 100 to 1 for a horizontal distance of 20,000 ft. from the nearest point of the nearest runway

processes.short_name_es: Aviso de altura a la FAA
processes.summary: Tall structures or sites near airports need an FAA notice.
processes.summary_es: Estructuras altas o cerca de aeropuertos requieren aviso a la FAA.

incentives.name: Act 60-2019 green-energy incentives decree (4% income tax rate)
incentives.eligibility_summary: Businesses producing or selling green energy at a commercial level in Puerto Rico, or assembling/installing green-energy equipment, may apply for a decree.
incentives.ineligible_reason: Generating solely for your own consumption is not listed as an eligible Act 60 green-energy activity.
incentives.controlling_language: Exempt Businesses with a Decree granted under this Chapter shall be subject to a preferential fixed income tax rate of four percent (4%)

incentives.name: Act 60 special deduction for investment in green-energy buildings and equipment
incentives.eligibility_summary: A decree holder may elect to deduct, in the year incurred, expenses for new (not previously used in PR) buildings, structures, machinery and equipment.
incentives.ineligible_reason: Applies to newly acquired/constructed assets not previously used or depreciated in Puerto Rico.
incentives.controlling_language: Any Exempt Business holding a Decree granted under this Chapter shall be granted the option of deducting in the Taxable Year in which they are incurred, instead of any capitalization, the total expenses incurred after the Effective Date of the Decree in the purchase, acquisition, or construction of buildings, structures, machinery, and equipment
incentives.notes: Available only to an Exempt Business holding an Act 60 green-energy decree (§ 2072.06(a)); SmartPR's incentive catalog entry PR_ACT60_RENEWABLE_INVESTMENT was corrected to say so.

derived_facts.label: Market segment
derived_facts.notes: Data-driven routing between customer-side distributed generation (DG, net metering) and wholesale / utility-scale generation. Never asked directly: questions go to power_offtaker.

cases.summary: The output is for the owner’s own use (self-supply, behind the meter, net metering, or a rooftop/carport system of 5 MW or less).
cases.controlling_language: “Generador distribuido” — Significará cualquier persona natural o jurídica, que tenga una instalación de generación eléctrica en Puerto Rico primordialmente para su propio consumo y que puede proveer electricidad generada en exceso de su consumo a la red eléctrica.

cases.summary: The plant sells its output to PREPA/LUMA or another buyer, or connects in front of the meter (independent power producer).
cases.controlling_language: “Productor independiente de energía”. — Significará toda persona, natural o jurídica, dedicada a la producción o generación de potencia eléctrica en Puerto Rico, para su venta mediante Contratos de Compraventa de Energía o cualquier otro negocio jurídico que autorice el Negocio.

cases.summary: A system at an existing facility.
cases.controlling_language: “Generador distribuido” — Significará cualquier persona natural o jurídica, que tenga una instalación de generación eléctrica en Puerto Rico primordialmente para su propio consumo y que puede proveer electricidad generada en exceso de su consumo a la red eléctrica.

cases.summary: Nothing indicates a standalone plant and the system is 5 MW or less — the ceiling for customer-side generation under Act 114-2007 and PREPA Reg. 8916.
cases.controlling_language: Las disposiciones de este Reglamento aplican a todo GD con capacidad máxima instalada de potencia de corriente alterna (AC) de 5 MW o menos que se interconecte con el sistema de transmisión o subtransmisión eléctrica de la Autoridad.

stages.name_es: Terreno, uso de suelo y ambiental

stages.name: Interconnection studies & technical requirements
stages.name_es: Estudios de interconexión y requisitos técnicos

stages.name: Testing, commissioning & commercial operation (COD)
stages.name_es: Pruebas, puesta en servicio y operación comercial (COD)

legacy_suppressions.reason: Wholesale plants that sell their output are independent power producers, not distributed generation, so the DG interconnection and net-metering registrations do not apply.
legacy_suppressions.reason_es: Las plantas que venden su producción son productores independientes, no generación distribuida: la interconexión de GD y la medición neta no aplican.
